stormfang-gunship.transport: This unit can transport 6 SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR, JUMP PACK or WULFEN model takes the space of two other models. It can not transport PRIMARIS models.

infernum-pattern-razorback.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS, TERMINATOR, CENTURION or JUMP PACK units.

relic-land-raider-proteus.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

land-raider-helios.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.name: Terrax-pattern Termite Assault Drill
terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, TERMINATOR, CENTURION, PRIMARIS or WULFEN models.

land-raider-prometheus.name: Land Raider Prometheus
land-raider-prometheus.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

land-raider-achilles.name: Land Raider Achilles
land-raider-achilles.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

relic-spartan-assault-tank.name: Relic Spartan Assault Tank
relic-spartan-assault-tank.transport: This unit can transport up to 25 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.name: Relic Mastodon Super-heavy Siege Transport
relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.transport:
This unit can transport friendly SPACE WOLVES models in one of the following combinations:
- Up to 40 INFANTRY models.
- Up to 30 INFANTRY models and 1 DREADNOUGHT model.
- Up to 20 INFANTRY models and up to 2 DREADNOUGHT models. 
TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

storm-eagle-assault-gunship.name: Storm Eagle Assault Gunship
storm-eagle-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

caestus-assault-ram.name: Caestus Assault Ram
caestus-assault-ram.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, CENTURION or TERMINATOR models.

thunderhawk-assault-gunship.name: Thunderhawk Assault Gunship
thunderhawk-assault-gunship.transport:
This unit can transport friendly SPACE WOLVES models in one of the following combinations:
- Up to 30 INFANTRY (excluding PRIMARIS) or BIKER models.
- Up to 15 PRIMARIS INFANTRY models.
Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models.

thunderhawk-transporter.name: Thunderhawk Transporter
thunderhawk-transporter.transport:
This unit can transport up to 15 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY or BIKER models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

In addition, this unit can also transport one of the following:
- 1 LAND RAIDER model or RELIC SPARTAN ASSAULT TANK model.
- Up to 2 of the following models: RHINO, RAZORBACK, PREDATOR, WHIRLWIND, HUNTER, STALKER, VINDICATOR. 

LAND RAIDER, RELIC SPARTAN ASSAULT TANK, RHINO and RAZORBACK models can transport models whilst they are embarked aboard this unit.

sokar-pattern-stormbird.name: Sokar Pattern Stormbird
sokar-pattern-stormbird.transport: This unit can transport up to 50 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY or BIKER models, or up to 25 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY or BIKER models amd 1 RHINO model. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models. A RHINO can transport models whilst it is embarked aboard this unit.

damocles-command-rhino.name: Damocles Command Rhino
damocles-command-rhino.transport: This unit can transport 1 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY CHARACTER model. It cannot transport PRIMARIS, CENTURION or TERMINATOR model

lucius-pattern-dreadnought-drop-pod.name: Lucius Pattern Dreadnought Drop Pod
lucius-pattern-dreadnought-drop-pod.transport: This unit can transport 1 friendly SPACE WOLVES DREADNOUGHT model.

castellum-stronghold-tacticus-bunker.name: Castellum Stronghold - Tacticus Bunker
castellum-stronghold-tacticus-bunker.transport: This unit can transport up to 30 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models.

castellum-stronghold-bunker-annex.name: Castellum Stronghold - Bunker Annex
castellum-stronghold-bunker-annex.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models.

impulsor.name: Impulsor
impulsor.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly SPACE WOLVES PRIMARIS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK or MK X GRAVIS units.

thane-to-the-high-king.name: Thane to the High King
thane-to-the-high-king.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

champion-of-the-kingsguard.name: Champion of the Kingsguard
champion-of-the-kingsguard.text: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target CHARACTERS.

ancient-tactician.name: Ancient Tactician
ancient-tactician.text: If this unit is on the battlefield at the start of the Generate Command Assets step, you generate one extra Command Asset.

last-of-the-company-of-russ.name: Last of the Company of Russ
last-of-the-company-of-russ.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

lord-of-the-wolfkin.name: Lord of the Wolfkin
lord-of-the-wolfkin.text: If this unit is a Warlord, then whilst it is on the battlefield, add 2" to the Move characteristic of THUNDERWOLF, FENRISIAN WOLVES or CYBERWOLVES in this unit’s Detachment.

born-of-wolves.name: Born of Wolves
born-of-wolves.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly Fenrisian Wolves and Cyberwolves units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

champion-of-the-deathwolves.name: Champion of the Deathwolves
champion-of-the-deathwolves.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

master-psyker.name: Master Psyker
master-psyker.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Orders phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck and draw either one Adeptus Astartes Command Asset of your choice that is a psychic power, or the Deny the Witch or Adamantium Will card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.

war-howl.name: War Howl
war-howl.text: If this unit is a Warlord, then whilst it is on the battlefield, add 2" to the Move characteristic of LIGHT SPACE WOLVES units in this unit’s Detachment.

the-redmaw.name: The Redmaw
the-redmaw.text: When you issue an order to this unit’s Detachment, roll one D6. If the result is less than the current turn number, this unit becomes the Redmaw and you no longer roll as described previously; this unit gains the Ignore Damage (6+) ability and you can add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit for the rest of the battle.

battlesmith.name: Battlesmith
battlesmith.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly SPACE WOLVES VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

omni-scramblers.name: Omni-scramblers
omni-scramblers.text: Enemy units cannot be set up within 12" of this unit during the Set Up Reinforcements step.

master-of-mischief.name: Master of Mischief
master-of-mischief.text: This unit cannot be a WARLORD.

last-laugh.name: Last Laugh
last-laugh.text: When this unit is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, choose one enemy unit in base contact with this unit and place one blast marker next to that unit. This might mean that damage needs to be resolved on the same unit more than once during the Damage phase.

pelt-of-the-doppelgangrel.name: Pelt of the Doppelgangrel
pelt-of-the-doppelgangrel.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target this unit

death-frenzy.name: Death Frenzy
death-frenzy.text: Add 1 to this unit’s Attacks characteristic if it has any damage markers next to it.

curse-of-the-wulfen.name: Curse of the Wulfen
curse-of-the-wulfen.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly LIGHT SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

force-of-untamed-destruction.name: Force of Untamed Destruction
force-of-untamed-destruction.text: This unit cannot be a WARLORD.

murderlust.name: Murderlust
murderlust.text: At the start of the Action phase, if this unit is within 1" of any enemy units that have any blast markers next to them, add 1 to this unit’s Attacks characteristic until the end of that phase.

hunters-beyond-death.name: Hunters Beyond Death
hunters-beyond-death.text:
When this unit makes a Shoot action, add 2 to hit rolls and you can reroll wound rolls for attacks made by this unit that target a PSYKER for that action.
Additionally, when this unit makes a Fight action, add 1 to hit rolls and you can reroll the wound roll for attacks made by this unit that target a PSYKER for that action.

morkais-howl-and-runic-totems.name: Morkai's Howl and Runic Totems
morkais-howl-and-runic-totems.text: This unit cannot be targeted or affected by Command Assets that are psychic powers, or weapons with the Witchfire ability. PSYKER units within 6" of this unit cannot be selected to manifest psychic powers.

mind-lock.name: Mind Lock
mind-lock.text: Change this unit’s Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics to 4+ whilst it is within 6" of at least one friendly SPACE WOLVES IRON PRIEST.

high-king-of-fenris.name: High King of Fenris
high-king-of-fenris.text: Morale tests taken for friendly WOLF GUARD units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

the-great-wolf.name: The Great Wolf
the-great-wolf.text: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for attacks made by friendly SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

jarl-of-fenris.name: Jarl of Fenris
jarl-of-fenris.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

spiritual-leader.name: Spiritual Leader
spiritual-leader.text: Friendly SPACE WOLVES units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

healing-balms.name: Healing Balms
healing-balms.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly SPACE WOLVES LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

slayers-oath.name: Slayer's Oath
slayers-oath.text: You can re-roll failed hit rolls made for friendly SPACE WOLVES units when using melee weapons whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

huskarl-to-the-jarl.name: Huskarl to the Jarl
huskarl-to-the-jarl.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

great-company-banner.name: Great Company Banner
great-company-banner.text: Morale tests taken for friendly SPACE WOLVES units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

great-company-veterans.name: Great Company Veterans
great-company-veterans.text: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit.

castellum-stronghold.name: Castellum Stronghold
castellum-stronghold.text: This unit can only be included in a Fortification Network Detachment that only includes 1 SPACE WOLVES Tacticus Bunker unit and 3 SPACE WOLVES Bunker Annex units. All 3 Bunker Annex units occupy a single Fortification slot, and the Tacticus Bunker begins the battle as the Commander of its Detachment.
